newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EU okays Clariant integrating Hoechst unit.
newsitem.headline: EU okays Clariant integrating Hoechst unit.

text.p: Clariant International AG said the European Commission on June 10 had approved the integration of Hoechst Specialty Chemicals into the Swiss speciality chemicals group.
Clariant said in a statement that the transaction is likely to be completed very soon and the start of operations for the expanded group is scheduled for July 1.
Agreements between the companies are to be signed in the next few days.
The deal has already been approved by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and the shareholders of both companies.
Further details on Clariant will be announced when the listing prospectus for the planned capital increase of Clariant is published in early July, it added.
More detailed information on Clariant's first half performance is planned for a news and analysts' conference in September.
